texts.preamble: Kiritkumar Gordhanbhai Patel, Food ... vs State Of Gujarat on 18 April, 2024 N R/Cr.Ma/5656/2021 Order
texts.arguments: advocate Mr.Devang Bhatt submits that the judgment and order of acquittal was passed by the learned trial Court mainly on the ground that Rules 2.4.1(8)(13) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 was not followed by the complainant. Learned advocate Mr.Bhatt submits that as per the evidence of the complainant and the Panch Witness, it NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/5656/2021 ORDER DATED: 18/04/2024 undefined comes on record that, after taking 40% strength of the preservative i.e. formalin 40-40 drops were added, the sample was taken. Kiritkumar Learned advocate Mr.Bhatt submits that as per Rule 2.4.1(8) nature and quantity of preservative is to be described which was followed by the complainant while giving the evidence before the learned trial Court. Learned advocate Mr.Bhatt submits that as per Rule 2.4.1(13) it is mandatory that nature and quantity of preservative added shall be clearly noted on the label to be fixed to the container. 2.Learned advocate Mr.Bhatt submits that as per the Panch Witness as well as from the evidence of the complainant, it transpires that though all procedures prescribed under the Act was followed, learned trial Court has acquitted the respondent-accused.
